english.title: Cause or permit another to falsify / conceal / destroy documents relevant to a Bank of England investigation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowing or suspecting that an investigation was being or was likely to be conducted under paragraph 121, 122 or 123 of Schedule 11 to the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 caused or permitted another, namely **(..SPECIFY OTHER PARTY..), to falsify, conceal, destroy or otherwise dispose of a document, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT..), knowing or suspecting it was or would have been relevant to such an investigation
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 132(4)(b) and (7) of Schedule 11 to the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Paragraph 133 of Schedule 11 provides that proceedings for this offence may only be instituted by the Bank or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions (in England and Wales).
